basic_info.description: Discover luxurious city living in this stunning townhouse style unit located in the vibrant Inner Mission. This spacious two bedroom, one and a half bath home spans across three levels in a 2004 custom-built, two-unit building. Bathed in natural light from a dramatic two-story wall of windows and skylights, the open kitchen, dining, and living area create a bright and inviting space. The kitchen boasts a gas range, granite countertops and eat-in bar for seamless cooking and entertaining.  Step onto your private balcony to soak in the neighborhood's vibrant energy amid a verdant garden.  A tucked away half bathroom completes this floor. The lofted primary bedroom with a spa-like bathroom overlooks the lower level.  A striking spiral staircase leads to the top-floor retreat, complete with custom built-ins, sliding glass doors, and access to expansive private roof offering breathtaking Twin Peaks views. Thoughtful design meets convenience with dedicated private storage, private laundry, and one deeded parking space in a shared garage.  Walk out the front door to Tartine Manufactory, Gus's Community Market, Sightglass Coffee, Trick Dog, Bon Nene, The Morris, Ernest, Flour & Water and so much more. Effortless access to Hwy 101 makes commuting a breeze. Don't miss this gem!
